Letter.title: Letter
Letter.description: A letter submitted to Hạ Vi Vi's winter mailbox under Tâm sự, Feedback, or Góp ý tưởng, with optional attached image.

sender.description: Display name of the sender or anonymous label.

isAnonymous.description: Whether the sender chose to hide their name.

content.description: Body text of the mailbox letter.

topic.description: Mailbox category selected by the sender.

stamp.description: Decorative winter stamp chosen for the envelope.

imageUrl.description: Optional compressed image Data URI or HTTPS image URL attached to the letter.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the letter was sealed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest heart or reply count update.

createdAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds used for deterministic chronological ordering.

createdAtLabel.description: Formatted Vietnamese timestamp label displayed on the envelope.

heartsCount.description: Number of warm hearts given to this letter.

repliesCount.description: Number of replies in the letter's replies subcollection.

status.description: Moderation visibility status of the letter.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID if signed in, or 'anonymous' for unauthenticated visitors.

LetterReply.title: LetterReply
LetterReply.description: A reply message posted beneath a mailbox letter.

sender.description: Display name of the reply author.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the reply was created.

isCreator.description: True only when posted by verified creator Hạ Vi Vi.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID if signed in, or 'anonymous'.

/letters/{letterId}.description: Publicly readable approved letters in Hạ Vi Vi's winter mailbox.

/letters/{letterId}/replies/{replyId}.description: Subcollection of replies associated with a specific mailbox letter.
